## Staff maintenance

For infrastructure-only PRs, replace the section above with the change, reason,
and local validation. Keep maintenance separate from project file changes.
Review any changes to workflows, validators, policies, or CODEOWNERS directly;
a passing check does not establish that proposed code is trusted.
